horizontal: 0.500 1.910 S1 Welcome back to the workshop.
1.910 4.400 S1 Today we look at how / captions are cut for phones.
4.400 6.954 S1 Most subtitle files / were written for a wide screen,
6.954 9.100 S1 with lines of forty characters or more.
9.100 13.806 S1 On a phone that becomes four or five short / lines, and nobody can read that fast.
